title: Remediate CVE-2026-85747 (upgrade to github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2)
body:
Please update code base to github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 v3.1.2 to remediate CVE-2026-85747.


Current workaround 
```
# ---- START CVE-2026-85747 workaround ----------------------------------------
# Remove this entire block once all three upstream modules have migrated away from
# github.com/docker/distribution:
#   - containers/skopeo       (cmd/skopeo/utils.go, cmd/skopeo/inspect.go)
#   - go.podman.io/common     (pkg/retry/retry.go, pkg/json-proxy/utils.go)
#   - go.podman.io/image/v5   (docker/docker_client.go, docker/docker_image_{src,dest}.go,
#                              docker/distribution_error.go, docker/errors.go)
#
# Why a plain `go mod edit -replace` is NOT sufficient:
#   Source files across skopeo and its vendored dependencies import the old path
#   directly. Go rejects one module satisfying two different module paths and fails:
#     "github.com/distribution/distribution/v3@v3.1.2 used for two different
#      module paths (github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 and
#      github.com/docker/distribution)"
#
# Sequence matters: go.mod + skopeo source patches must come first so that
# `go mod tidy && go mod vendor` resolves v3 correctly; vendored dependency
# source patches and vendor dir cleanup must come AFTER vendor is regenerated,
# because go mod vendor overwrites those files. A final `go mod edit -droprequire`
# removes the indirect entry that go mod tidy re-adds, and eliminates the module
# from the binary entirely (verified: `go version -m skopeo` shows only v3).

# Step 1: update go.mod (before tidy)
go mod edit -dropreplace github.com/docker/distribution
go mod edit -droprequire  github.com/docker/distribution
go mod edit -require       github.com/distribution/distribution/v3@v3.1.2

# Step 2: patch skopeo's own source files (before tidy)
sed -i 's|"github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/errcode"|"github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/errcode"|g' \
  cmd/skopeo/inspect.go \
  cmd/skopeo/utils.go
sed -i 's|"github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/v2"|"github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/v2"|g' \
  cmd/skopeo/utils.go

# Step 3: regenerate vendor (go mod tidy re-adds docker/distribution as indirect;
#          go mod vendor re-populates vendor/github.com/docker/distribution)
go mod tidy && go mod vendor

# Step 4: patch vendored go.podman.io/common (AFTER vendor is regenerated)
sed -i 's|"github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/errcode"|"github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/errcode"|g' \
  vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/retry/retry.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/json-proxy/utils.go
sed -i 's|errcodev2 "github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/v2"|errcodev2 "github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/v2"|g' \
  vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/retry/retry.go
sed -i 's|dockerdistributionapi "github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/v2"|dockerdistributionapi "github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/v2"|g' \
  vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/json-proxy/utils.go

# Step 5: patch vendored go.podman.io/image/v5 (AFTER vendor is regenerated)
sed -i 's|"github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/errcode"|"github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/errcode"|g' \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_client.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_image_src.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_image_dest.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/distribution_error.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/errors.go
sed -i 's|v2 "github.com/docker/distribution/registry/api/v2"|v2 "github.com/distribution/distribution/v3/registry/api/v2"|g' \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_client.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_image_src.go \
  vendor/go.podman.io/image/v5/docker/docker_image_dest.go

# Step 6: remove old vendor source and modules.txt entry so nothing links docker/distribution
rm -rf vendor/github.com/docker/distribution
python3 -c "
import re, sys
txt = open('vendor/modules.txt').read()
txt = re.sub(
    r'^# github\.com/docker/distribution v2\.8\.3\+incompatible\n## explicit\n(github\.com/docker/distribution[^\n]*\n)*',
    '',
    txt,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)
open('vendor/modules.txt', 'w').write(txt)
"

# Step 7: drop the indirect go.mod entry that go mod tidy re-added in Step 3
#         (required so the vendor consistency check matches modules.txt)
go mod edit -droprequire github.com/docker/distribution
# ---- END CVE-2026-85747 workaround ------------------------------------------
```

comments.body:
Thanks for reaching out.

Skopeo does not even _contain_ the code affected by CVE-2026-85747. As the text above notes, distribution/v2 types are, ~effectively, a part of the public and committed API of the used libraries. Arguably, the API never committed to those types, and we might want to migrate eventually, but we are certainly not going to do that in a rush for an inapplicable vulnerability.
